title: P4.11 — authoritative Laravel Gate and P9/P03 parity
text: 09 §§1/5/7; V27–V30/V64/V93: native provider Gate::before callback resolves the shared PanelResolver and Authorizer pipeline. Full/prefix names own before catalog lookup; unknown owned names deny with log. Local static/dynamic abilities and single-word+model/class indexed pairs; ambiguous pair denies. Null only for foreign names; static foreign lookup and unbound model abilities cause0DB queries/0source reads. Dynamic tentative local ownership requires permission metadata lookup but no assignments for absent name; one prepared evaluation, no duplicate dynamic poll. Response message/status/code, including404 and code0, survive Gate::inspect. GateOwnership/PanelSelection/Response/EarlyGateBefore tests cover foreign native policy fallback, GateSource mapped external policy without Grants authority, conflicting resource class, tenant/context owner mismatch and actual boot callback. GateParityTest and ScenarioGenerator::gateArguments prove200 seed P9 decide/decideMany/explain/Gate equality. P03 spec/map transferred together to P4.11 perD14§7; regression covers positive then denying hook/source across current adapters includingBlade@can/CLI. P09 adds actualGate while retaining P2.2 resolver owner. Future trait P5.1/facade P6.1/middleware P6.2 remain explicit. Early permissive host Gate::before is a tested integration limitation, doctor P6.4 remains future. Installed Laravel framework v13.33.0. Native whole-scope Grok4.7/high review pending; no context parameter. Evidence artifacts/P4.10-P4.11-execution.
